The league and cup winners would enter the [[2011 AFC Cup]]. The bottom side at the end of the season get relegated. The side that finishes 2ND from bottom enters an end of season play-off match against the 2nd Division's 2nd placed side. ==Teams== [[ Hồ Chí Minh City F.C.|Ho Chi Minh City]] and [[Thanh Hóa F.C. (1962)|Thanh Hóa]] were relegated to the [[2010 Vietnam First Division]] after finishing the [[2009 V-League|2009 season]] in the bottom two places. The two relegated teams were replaced by [[2009 Vietnam First Division]] champions [[XM The Vissai Ninh Bình]] and runners-up [[Hòa Phát Hà Nội]]. [[Nam Định F.C.|Nam Định]] defeated Thành phố Cần Thơ in the end of season promotion/relegation match to secure their place in the V. League. Thể Công and Quân Khu 4 were renamed to [[Viettel F.C.]] and [[Navibank Sài Gòn]] at the end of the 2009 campaign.{{Cite web |title=NAVIBANK TAKE OVER FOURTH MILITARY ZONE |url=https://www.aseanfootball.org/v3/navibank-take-over-fourth-military-zone/ |website=ASEAN Football Federation |access-date=13 May 2025 |language=en}} Viettel then sold their V.
